warmup: Dr. Nair here, on the dock! Drag the magnet onto a muddy shape. Tap your guess: Clank, or Nothing. Then reel it up. Six casts. Watch the haul list. What do the clanks have in common?
part1: Our third magnet lost its letters. Flip the test magnet, then drag it to an end. Does it snap in, or scoot away? Check your test log, then paint the letter. Then, snap it in half!
part2: Every thing on this tray is metal. Drag the magnet wand slowly across the tray. Some things jump up and cling. Some stay put. Read each made-of tag. Is every metal magnetic?
explore: Predict every row first. Tap Yes or No for all eight. Then lock your chart. Now drag the magnet onto each row. Wrong guesses get circled. That is where the learning is. Then finish the rule.
